steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

steps.name: restore
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; checkpoint='/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/matrixhub/checkpoints/20260906-fix-frontend-quality-debt-v7/1788671046808508000-task-exit'; git apply "$checkpoint/tracked.patch"; cp "$checkpoint/untracked/interface/scripts/run-vitest.mjs" interface/scripts/run-vitest.mjs

steps.name: fix-blob-test
steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('interface/src/lib/services/api/monitoring/LogsApiService.test.ts')
s=p.read_text()
old="\t\texpect(await blob.text()).toBe('demo-binary');"
new="\t\texpect(blob).toBeInstanceOf(Blob);\n\t\texpect(blob.size).toBe('demo-binary'.length);\n\t\texpect(blob.type).toBe('application/octet-stream');"
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'blob assertion match count={s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
git diff --check

steps.name: prepare
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts; npx prettier --write project.inlang/.meta.json project.inlang/README.md scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/lib/services/api/monitoring/LogsApiService.test.ts; cd ..; git diff --check

steps.name: focused-test
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; node ./scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/lib/services/api/monitoring/LogsApiService.test.ts

steps.name: frontend-quality
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm run quality:frontend

steps.name: commit-and-push
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git diff --check; git add interface/package.json interface/scripts/run-vitest.mjs interface/src/lib/storage.svelte.ts interface/src/routes/charts/components/DateSelector.svelte interface/src/lib/features/gpio/gpioModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/power/powerConfigModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/matrix/matrixNavigation.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/matrix/matrixModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/usb/terminal/usbTerminalCommandPresets.ts interface/src/lib/features/usb/terminal/useUsbTerminalQuickScripts.svelte.ts interface/src/lib/services/api/monitoring/LogsApiService.test.ts; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Fix frontend quality debt'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
